title: Lakshmi Nivas
desc: Veer keeps his secret hidden from the family. Hurt by Vivek's harsh words, Niya and Radhika move in with Raj. Aishwarya blames Revati for theft but plans to leave the house when the truth is revealed.

desc: As Aryavardhan and Anu share a romantic moment, Meera vows revenge. Amid the haldi ceremony, Meera and Jalandhar plot a scheme and isolate Anu to trap her.

title: Jagadhatri
desc: A joyful morning turns sour as Rekha humiliates Jagadhatri in front of the family. While Shivay defends her, Rekha vows to create more trouble, intensifying tensions at home.

title: Saru
desc: A disguised Saru greets Ved on his birthday. Annapurna thinks about Saru, believing that she could never hurt her family. Later, Saru goes to meet an MLA, unaware that he is Ved.
